weaknesses.title: var_slot create-cap 64 vs LET 128 — DECIDE silent bind miss
weaknesses.detail: cubalc_lang_var_slot() refuses create when n_vars>=64; var_get/LET allow 128. After LIST/EACH/GREP realworld walks, n_vars often exceeds 64. DECIDE brain still computes and prints 'decide N' but fails to create DECIDE/DIGIT plate vars (returns NULL silently). LET dig = DECIDE then yields 0. Agents trust board noise / dig plate and get wrong severity.
weaknesses.repro: Run programs/realworld/log_event_triage.cubalc without early LET DECIDE=-1; observe decide 3 then dig=0 / DECIDE missing from VARS. With pre-bind LET DECIDE=-1 at start, dig=3.

weaknesses.title: VARS JSON collapses newlines in multi-line strings
weaknesses.detail: VARS plate serializes LIST/GREP/body strings without preserving \n — e.g. LIST basenames become concatenated 'a.logb.log', GREP hits 'ERROR aERROR b'. Agents re-parsing VARS cannot recover field structure; PRINT_JSON of scalar counts still works.
weaknesses.repro: SYS LIST programs/lib; VARS — inspect vars.LIST for missing newlines between basenames.

weaknesses.title: nested EACH LINE clobbers shared LINE/IT/IDX
weaknesses.detail: Outer EACH LINE AS fname preserves fname, but after inner EACH LINE the shared LINE/IT/IDX/LINE_N remain from the inner loop (last hit). Easy to mis-read outer progress if code uses LINE after nested walk.
weaknesses.repro: EACH LINE AS fname IN a\nb; EACH LINE AS hit IN x\ny; END; PRINT_JSON fname LINE IT — fname ok, LINE=y IT=1.

weaknesses.title: GREP single case-sensitive substring — no OR/regex/i
weaknesses.detail: SYS GREP uses strstr only. Cannot match ERROR|FAIL|CRIT in one pass; lowercase 'error' misses NEEDLE=ERROR. Real log triage needs multi-needle or case-fold.
weaknesses.repro: body with 'error lower' + GREP ERROR → GREP_N=0; FAIL lines ignored when needle is ERROR.

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN still undiscoverable via forms/search
weaknesses.detail: SYS JOIN|PATH is implemented and required for STATE/logs joins but forms JOIN and search JOIN return n=0. Agents must know the op from folklore/programs.

weaknesses.title: LIST soft-fail sticky err_line=0; GREP/EACH 512-char field trunc
weaknesses.detail: LIST on non-dir sets last_err but err_line=0 (plate less useful under -s). GREP and EACH LINE copy each field into 512-byte stack buffers — long log lines truncate for match/walk.
weaknesses.repro: SYS LIST file-path under -s; 600+ char ERROR line → first_hit truncated.

workarounds: LET DECIDE = -1 (and DIGIT) early while n_vars is low so var_slot can update existing slots after walk
UNSET large temps before DECIDE as secondary pressure relief (not always enough alone)
Use PRINT_JSON of scalar counters rather than re-parsing multi-line strings from VARS
Bind outer loop with EACH LINE AS name; do not trust LINE after nested EACH
Run multiple GREP passes for multi-severity (ERROR then FAIL) and sum GREP_N
SYS UPPER before GREP if case-fold needed (ASCII only)
language_gaps: Unify var_slot and var_get create caps (64 vs 128) or error loudly when DECIDE plate bind fails
VARS JSON must escape/preserve newlines in string values
Accurate err_line for host soft fails (LIST/SIZE/READ)
Optional recursive LIST or ** glob for nested log trees
